GitHub Issue:
Post Date: 2022-10-17T21:03:45Z
Current Date: April 4 2025
Title: Message flag 'seen' does not persist on Exchange server
Description: Hi, I was tasked with downloading messages from an old Exchange server 2010 (yes you read correctly).
I am able to set the flag to seen and the server seems to acknowledge the request. However next time around this same message (based on uid) has no flags set.

Code which opens the folder in question and sets the flag:
```
var folder = await Client.GetFolderAsync(folderPath, CancellationToken);
await folder.OpenAsync(FolderAccess.ReadWrite, CancellationToken);
try
{
	await folder.RemoveFlagsAsync(uniqueId, MessageFlags.Seen, true);
}
finally
{
	await folder.CloseAsync();
}
```

Protocol log acknowledging the update:
```
C: A00000009 SELECT INBOX
S: * 4 EXISTS
S: * 0 RECENT
S: * FLAGS (\Seen \Answered \Flagged \Deleted \Draft $MDNSent)
S: * OK [PERMANENTFLAGS (\Seen \Answered \Flagged \Deleted \Draft $MDNSent)] Permanent flags
S: * OK [UNSEEN 1] Is the first unseen message
S: * OK [UIDVALIDITY 7937] UIDVALIDITY value
S: * OK [UIDNEXT 67167] The next unique identifier value
S: A00000009 OK [READ-WRITE] SELECT completed.
C: A00000010 UID STORE 67162 -FLAGS.SILENT (\Seen)
S: A00000010 OK STORE completed.
C: A00000011 LOGOUT
S: * BYE Microsoft Exchange Server 2010 IMAP4 server signing off.
S: A00000011 OK LOGOUT completed.
```

Is there something I am doing wrong?

Thank you.
